about: Labelled queries over the store test/seed-retrieval.js builds. Titles, not ids: the ids move if the seed changes, the titles are what a reader can check. Every title here must exist in the seeded store; bench/retrieval.py refuses a label it cannot find, so a seed change breaks the bench loudly instead of quietly grading nothing.

queries.note: Past the embedder's window, which is the prompt a person actually sends: the question first, then the paste. The trace must record the truncation and the result must still be graded. It is allowed to come back degraded: 30 rerank pairs against 2000 characters of query take longer than the 5000 ms ceiling a prompt gives one runtime call (measured 2026-09-17: 6.2 s degraded at the default, 9.1 s and no degradation at --runtime-timeout-ms 20000), so the reranker is lost on a pasted log and the merge order is what comes back.
